nodes.label: Normalized tracking model
nodes.rationale: The only shape the frontend receives; minimal data, no PII.

nodes.label: Shopify App Proxy /apps/nordic-tracking
nodes.rationale: Calls go to the store's own domain and Shopify signs them; HMAC signature verified server-side.

nodes.label: POST /apps/nordic-tracking/track
nodes.rationale: Only DHL lookup; never link tracking number to a Shopify order.

nodes.label: Order enumeration protection (identical not_found)
nodes.rationale: Never reveal whether an order number exists: same response and timing, constant-time email compare.

nodes.label: Rate limiting per IP and per order number
nodes.norm_label: rate limiting per ip and per order number

nodes.label: Brief to Design System Map
nodes.rationale: Do not invent CSS for things that have an official package.

nodes.label: Shopify Polaris
nodes.rationale: Required for Shopify admin UI (apps only).

nodes.label: The Three Dials (DESIGN_VARIANCE / MOTION_INTENSITY / VISUAL_DENSITY)
nodes.rationale: Baseline 8/6/4; every layout, motion, density decision is gated by these.

nodes.label: Anti-Default Discipline
nodes.rationale: Avoid LLM defaults: purple gradients, centered hero over mesh, three equal cards, Inter + slate-900.

nodes.label: Brief Inference / Design Read
nodes.rationale: Most LLM design output is bad because the model jumps to a default aesthetic instead of reading the room; audience picks the aesthetic.

nodes.label: Em-Dash Ban
nodes.rationale: The single most-violated AI tell.

nodes.label: Page Theme Lock / Dark Mode Protocol
nodes.norm_label: page theme lock / dark mode protocol

nodes.label: Performance & Accessibility Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Reduced motion and dark mode mandatory for consumer-facing pages.

nodes.label: Redesign Protocol (audit-first)
nodes.rationale: Existing brand assets are starting material; audit before touching; nothing changes silently.

nodes.label: Upgrade communicated in kronor, percent secondary
nodes.norm_label: upgrade communicated in kronor, percent secondary
nodes.rationale: Avoids sale feel; keeps premium positioning.

nodes.label: Data source setting (live / mock)
nodes.rationale: Mock only honored in unpublished theme or theme editor so test data never reaches customers.

nodes.label: Automatic upgrade line in bundle comparison
nodes.norm_label: automatic upgrade line in bundle comparison
nodes.rationale: Shown only when larger bundle contains everything in smaller so the amount is always correct. No sale design, no countdowns.

nodes.label: Cost data gaps in Shopify
nodes.rationale: Missing costs for DeepDegrease, Scrub Pad, Detail Brush Duo, Glass Towel; Litet interior cost wrongly set to 317 kr.

nodes.label: Exterior bundle family (Startkit / Komplett Kit)
nodes.rationale: Komplett 1 099 kr falls under the 1 100 kr threshold.

nodes.label: Exterior mid bundle proposal (Startkit + Foamtastic + GlossCoat, 719 kr)
nodes.norm_label: exterior mid bundle proposal (startkit + foamtastic + glosscoat, 719 kr)

nodes.label: Foam Wash Kit
nodes.rationale: Sits beside the ladder; cannot be a middle step since it lacks Startkit products.

nodes.label: Gross margin analysis
nodes.rationale: All tiers keep premium margin; interior lowest (~50%) due to Mikrofiberduk 5-pack.

nodes.label: Rim bundle family (Falg startkit / Falg & Dack Komplett)
nodes.norm_label: rim bundle family (falg startkit / falg & dack komplett)
nodes.rationale: Strongest upgrade in the store: +140 kr for 229 kr value.

nodes.label: Value per extra krona (upgrade metric)
nodes.rationale: Rises from 1.15-1.26 today to 1.28-1.64 with proposal.

nodes.label: Bra / Battre / Bast price ladder
nodes.rationale: Current discount is flat (13-19%) and larger bundles sometimes give lower discount, so no economic reason to upgrade; ladder of ~8-12% / 15-17% / 20-23%.

nodes.label: 30-day lowest price comparison rule
nodes.rationale: Do not market Komplett cut as a sale ('tidigare 1 199 kr') unless 30-day lowest-price rules are followed.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph (graphify-out)
nodes.rationale: Scoped query/path/explain subgraphs are smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.

nodes.label: Run graphify update after code changes
nodes.norm_label: run graphify update after code changes
nodes.rationale: Keeps graph current with AST-only, no API cost.
